files.name: motion-prompt-031.txt
PROMPT.md
files.content:
Please use "Crane up" (クレーンアップ), one of the names in "Camera moves & transitions".
Motion Prompt #031

What it is: Lift the camera up
What the sample shows: The camera rises while tilting down until it looks down on the person.
Spec:
- Camera: rises from 1.4 m to 9 m while moving forward 0 m → 1.5 m
- Direction: tilts down to keep the person (8 m ahead) in frame; pitch = -0.86 × atan2(height - 1.0, 8 - forward), about -2.5° → -44°
- Timing: 0.5 s to 3.4 s (2.9 s), cubic ease-in-out (about cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1))
- Subject: the person does not move; they get smaller as the camera rises, the ground grid fills the frame and the horizon leaves at the top
- Return: hold 3.4–4.2 s, then cross-fade back to the start over the last 0.5 s (one pass = 4.7 s)
- Top-right readout shows the height (↑ 1.4m → ↑ 9.0m)
When to use it: To pull away from a person at the end of a scene or to reveal how large the location is.

Reference implementation (Canvas 2D, a function whose picture depends only on the time): https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/en/e/031.txt
Shared helper code: https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/kit/camera.js
Keep the shapes, timing and easing values of the reference implementation as they are, and change only the text, colours and assets to fit what I am making.
